cohort: 701 cases of SMO and 1,402 controls with obstetric complications admitted to Keren Provincial Referral Hospital in Eritrea between January 2018 and December 2020
finding: Lack of ANC follow-up, caesarean section in the current pregnancy, referral from lower facilities, distance from the nearest health facility, history of anemia, and previous cesarean section were independently associated with SMO.
mod_finding: Caesarean section in the current pregnancy was independently associated with SMO.
